liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Shotgun center - This should be kept in the center of the mix. Used with Figure-8 for mid/side mix**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [2]
- **Figure-8 L/R stereo track - This must be kept at hard left and hard right. Bringing them towards the center will cause cancellation. Used with shotgun center for mid/side mix**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [2]
- **Cardioid left - can be anywhere in the left side of the mix, probably between the shotguns and Figure-8**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Cardioid right - can be anywhere in the right side of the mix, probably between the shotguns and Figure-8**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Shotgun left - can be anywhere in the left side, probably inside the cardioids**: rare: 5 archived performances [2]
- **Shotgun right - can be anywhere in the right side, probably inside the cardioids**: rare: 5 archived performances [2]

## The recordings

- **dac2021-08-27.AKGmultitrack.toaste.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 6 songs; 1164 min [1]. Said about its sound: The tracks must be mixed before listening; the uploader left the mixing choices to the listener [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dac2021-08-27.AKGmultitrack.toaste.flac16**: taped by Toaste; transferred by Toaste; source: 3x AKG398 shotguns (L,C,R); 1x AKG394 Figure-8 (L,R); 2x AKG391 cardioids (L,R) > Zoom F8 @ 44.1/16 [1]. Also: This upload is a set of unmixed single-microphone tracks, labeled AKG multitrack, in FLAC 16-bit format [1]
